name: kalasathi
description: KalaSaathi - Fullstack AI Business Manager for Marginalized Artisans

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "mvn -f server/pom.xml spring-boot:run" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: mvn -f server/pom.xml package -DskipTests && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: mvn -f server/pom.xml test && npm run test:ui --prefix frontend
